nodes.name: Sklearn Cluster Spectral Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level SpectralClustering, spectral_clustering, SpectralBiclustering, and SpectralCoclustering selection, solver-boundary, fit/function-payload, and fitted-state atoms above spectral embedding eigensolvers, SVD callbacks, KMeans assignment, discretize, cluster_qr, and bicluster projection callbacks.

nodes.name: spectral_public_surface_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public spectral clustering surface names useful for framework-level selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public surface-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: spectral_public_surface_family
nodes.description: Return the public spectral clustering family represented by a surface name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed surface names.

nodes.name: spectral_public_solver_boundary
nodes.description: Return the eigensolver, SVD, or KMeans/label-assignment callback boundary represented by a public spectral option.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom maps fixed public solver and assignment labels to callback-boundary categories.

nodes.name: spectral_public_fit_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public spectral estimator fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing eigensolver, SVD, or label-assignment callbacks.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit input and packages references without running spectral solvers.

nodes.name: spectral_clustering_function_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public spectral_clustering function payload before constructing and fitting the estimator wrapper.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates a dense square affinity matrix and packages references without clustering.

nodes.name: spectral_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public spectral estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: spectral_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted labels, affinity, row/column labels, indicator shapes, and solver-boundary metadata after deferred spectral execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom reads shapes and unique label counts from already-fitted arrays without recomputing spectral embeddings or assignments.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 5 and Case 6 public spectral clustering shells over eigensolver, SVD, KMeans, discretize, cluster_qr, and bicluster projection callback boundaries
limitations: Spectral embedding eigensolvers, ARPACK/LOBPCG/AMG behavior, SVD/randomized-SVD callbacks, KMeans or MiniBatchKMeans assignment, discretize, cluster_qr, bicluster projection, sparse log normalization, and estimator method execution remain delegated behavior.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not spectral clustering, biclustering, or coclustering execution.
